Tea at the Wrong Hour

marchhare_writes

Summary:

Alice tries to fix teatime. Teatime has opinions.

Chapter 4: The Clock Faces the Wall

Chapter Text

The tea had been poured at six o’clock, as it always was, and it was still six o’clock when Alice set her cup down for the third time.

“You could try moving the clock,” she suggested.

The Hatter looked at her as though she had proposed moving the river. “And have it sulk? It sulked for a week the last time anybody touched it. We had breakfast at teatime and supper in the bath.”

Alice thought about this. Then she reached across the table, very politely, and turned the clock to face the wall.

For a moment nothing happened at all. Then, somewhere under the table, something began very quietly to tick.

Chapter five is half written. The Dormouse is being difficult.
